name: Charlotte Reid
bio: A Representative from Illinois; born Charlotte Leota Thompson, September 27, 1913, in Kankakee, Ill.; graduated from East Aurora High School, Aurora, Ill., 1930; attended Illinois College, Jacksonville, Ill.; entertainer under the name of Annette King; active in civic, community, and political affairs; elected as a Republican to the Eighty-eighth and to the four succeeding Congresses until her resignation on October 7, 1971 (January 3, 1963-October 7, 1971); member of the Federal Communications Commission, 1971-1976; member, President's Task Force on International Private Enterprise, 1983-1985; member, board of overseers, Hoover Institution, 1984-1988; died on January 24, 2007, in Geneva, Ill.
